text:
jamie: FYI — Acme legal sent an audit ask: per-tenant signed audit export on demand + streaming for admin events, 90d retention, and cryptographic proof of integrity. Are we able to promise this in a contract?
priya: do they want delivered bundles only or also continuous push (webhook) for each admin op?
luke: short answer: both possible. Bundles = generate tar.gz signed with an HMAC envelope keyed by customer CMK via KMS. Streaming = signed JWT per event or TLS+mutual auth webhook.
jamie: they mentioned 'forensically verifiable' and timestamped signatures. also asked about retention guarantees and tamper-evidence.
eva: we need to ensure role/grant/revoke events are always logged — RBAC change events currently sampled at 1% in high-volume tenants. that'll need to be 100% for covered customers.
priya: sampling bump ok but perf/egress effects. estimate?
luke: expect ~2-4% token/bandwidth uplift for real-time delivery if we stop sampling. Bundles are cheaper (on-demand). Also KMS HMAC per-bundle is ~50ms on our side, can async sign in background.
tom: schema question — we'll need explicit fields for signer_kid, signature_algo, signed_at, canonicalized_payload. Proposing audit_schema v2 with event_version and lineage_id. Example:
```json
{
  "event_version": "2",
  "event_type": "rbac.change",
  "actor": "user:alice@example.com",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T21:14:32Z",
  "lineage_id": "uuid",
  "details": {"action":"grant","role":"admin"}
}
```
priya: +1. Also need a manifest for bundle signatures with an HMAC and KMS key id.
legal: from a contract standpoint we need precise acceptance criteria: the format of signed bundle, verification instructions, SLA for delivery time (e.g., 24h vs 72h), and retention start/end rules. We'll also ask for proof of key custody (KMS audit logs).
jamie: fedramp-like customers may insist on HSM-backed attestation and time-stamping via an external TSA. that's more heavyweight.
security-bot: NOTE: previous incident 2025-11-02 showed missing rbac.revoke events for 3 hours due to worker crash — need postmortem checks if we promise 100% fidelity.
eva: we'll need a durable queue + checkpointing for event export path and add end-to-end checksums per stream segment.
luke: ops impact: to meet 24h on-demand export SLA we need a prioritized export queue + throttles. Cost/revenue implication: add enterprise add-on.
priya: action items: 1) define audit_schema v2 spec (tom, eva) 2) KMS signing design doc (luke) 3) SLA/acceptance criteria draft (legal, jamie) 4) capacity & billing impact (eng-ops).
jamie: thanks. I'll sync with account team and loop in customer for clarification. cc @legal @eng-ops
priya: will create initial GH issue and tag eng-security.
jamie: :thumbsup:
